taglines: Friday. The sacred end-of-week ritual where we all pretend we'll wrap up properly and then absolutely do not.
The hotfix is in production. The hotfix needs a hotfix. The hotfix's hotfix has 'unknown behavior on weekends.' It is Friday.
Someone left a comment that says 'TODO: fix this.' The comment is from 2019. The someone is a legend. The something is still broken.
Your documentation is out of date. It was out of date when it was written. You wrote it. We don't talk about it.
The load balancer is fine. The database is fine. The servers are fine. Nothing is fine. Everything is vibes all the way down.
We said we'd refactor it after launch. Launch was eighteen months ago. The code has developed sentience. It's attached.
Congrats on surviving another sprint. The velocity chart looks like a cry for help if you tilt your head. You did it though.
It's not a bug, it's emergent behavior from a system that has clearly developed opinions. Respect the system. Fear the system.
